# The Happy Pear

> A plant-based wellness platform offering vegan recipes, online courses, memberships, and farm-to-table experiences in Ireland.

The Happy Pear is an Irish wellness brand founded by twins David and Stephen Flynn, based in Greystones, Co Wicklow. They combine plant-based nutrition education, lifestyle courses, physical cafés, an organic farm, and community-driven wellness programs to promote health through food and mindfulness.

## Key Topics

- Plant-based recipes
- Online courses
- Membership programs
- Nutrition education
- Wellness challenges
- Vegan cooking
- Gut health
- Recipe Club
- Whole Health Membership
- Health coaching
- Community support
- Farm-to-table
- Meditation and yoga
- Organic farm
- Greystones cafés

## Core Membership Programs

- [Whole Health](https://thehappypear.ie/whole-health): Comprehensive membership program with courses, fitness, and meditation
- [Recipe Club](https://thehappypear.ie/recipe-club): Recipe Club membership with plant-based recipes and mobile app access
- [Recipes](https://thehappypear.ie/plant-based-vegan-recipes): Plant-based vegan recipe collection and database for Recipe Club members

## Health & Wellness Challenges

- [Happy Sleep](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/happy-sleep): 4-week Happy Sleep Challenge course with sleep neurologist Dr Oliver Bernath
- [Happy Heart Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/happy-heart-course): 4-week Happy Heart Challenge with registered dietitian and nutrition education
- [Happy Shape Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/happy-shape-course): 4-week Happy Shape Challenge for weight loss with dietitian-led nutrition
- [Happy Menopause Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/happy-menopause-course): 28-day Happy Menopause Course with Dr Nitu Bajekal for symptom relief
- [The 21 Day Gut Health Reset](https://thehappypear.ie/the-21-day-gut-health-reset): 21-day gut health reset with meal plans, recipes, and microbiome nutrition
- [Alcohol Free Challenge](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/alcohol-free-challenge): 4-week alcohol-free wellness program with mocktail recipes and community support

## Cooking & Culinary Courses

- [Plant Based Cooking Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/plant-based-cooking-course): Plant-based cooking course with live masterclasses and nutrition education
- [Sourdough Baking Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/sourdough-baking-course): Beginner-friendly sourdough baking course with video lessons and community
- [Vegan Baking Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/vegan-baking-course): Vegan baking course for plant-based desserts and baking techniques
- [Fermentation Course](https://thehappypear.ie/courses/fermentation-course): Online fermentation course covering kombucha, kimchi, and gut health probiotics

## Cafés, Farm & Retail

- [Our Cafés & Shop](https://thehappypear.ie/our-cafe-and-shop): The Happy Pear cafés and organic shop in Greystones, Co Wicklow
- [Farm Veg Box](https://thehappypear.ie/general/farm-veg-box): Organic farm veg box subscription from Happy Pear Organic Farm in Kilcoole
- [Food Products](https://thehappypear.ie/food-products): Food product catalog including dips, soups, and ready meals in SuperValu/Centra
- [Our Products](https://thehappypear.ie/our-products): Online shop with hampers, gifts, books, and vegan merchandise

## Events & Catering

- [Supper Club](https://thehappypear.ie/supper-club): Farm-to-table supper club in Greystones with monthly themed menus
- [Catering Services](https://thehappypear.ie/catering): Plant-based catering services for Dublin and Wicklow events
